_comment: Terminals of timetables that print only departure times and no stop list (scanned PDFs, CAM / Rodoeste sheets). Hand-checked positions, snapped to the nearest road with OSRM /nearest; they give such a direction its two stops so the planner can use it. `lines` limits an entry to the lines whose terminal of that name it is (namesakes: Vargem, Moinhos, Eiras). Position labels name the OSM object they come from.
